skill.name: plannotator
skill.description: Review AI coding plans and diffs in a browser UI. Add annotations, request changes, approve plans, and save notes to Obsidian or Bear.
skill.summary: Browser-based plan and diff review for AI coding agents.
skill.author: supercent-io

security_audit.summary: The skill provides useful plan and diff review workflows, but it includes high-risk setup behavior. Confirmed issues include remote installer execution through pipe-to-shell patterns and persistent modification of AI tool configuration files under the user home directory. No explicit prompt-injection text targeting this audit was found.

remediation.issue: Remote installer is executed through curl-to-shell and similar Windows patterns.
remediation.suggestion: Replace pipe-to-shell installation with signed release artifacts, checksum verification, and instructions that download before execution.

remediation.issue: Setup scripts persist hooks, prompts, and developer instructions in AI tool configuration files.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation for each target file, show exact diffs before writing, and provide a rollback command for every change.

remediation.issue: Plan and feedback examples use /tmp for intermediate files.
remediation.suggestion: Use a private temporary directory with restrictive permissions and delete plan or feedback files after the review completes.

remediation.issue: OpenCode slash command setup creates executable commands with user-provided arguments.
remediation.suggestion: Validate allowed file paths, document argument handling, and avoid shell interpretation where direct argument arrays are available.

content.user_title: Review AI Agent Plans and Diffs
content.value_statement: AI coding agents can start work before humans catch risky plans or unclear diffs. plannotator adds a browser review loop for annotations, approvals, feedback, and note exports.
actual_capabilities: Opens a browser review UI for AI-generated implementation plans.
Supports delete, insert, replace, and comment annotations on plans.
Launches visual git diff review for uncommitted changes, commits, or branch ranges.
Provides setup scripts for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and OpenCode integrations.
Checks installed CLI, hooks, environment variables, notes apps, and git status.
Documents optional Obsidian and Bear note export workflows.
limitations: Requires the plannotator CLI and a usable browser session.
Setup scripts modify local AI tool, shell, or OpenCode configuration files.
The installer relies on an external plannotator.ai install script.
Obsidian and Bear saves depend on local app setup and hook-mode execution.

use_cases.title: Review Plans Before Coding
use_cases.description: Inspect an agent implementation plan, mark risky steps, and request changes before code is written.

use_cases.title: Annotate Diff Reviews
use_cases.description: Open a browser diff view, attach line-specific feedback, and send review notes back to the agent.

use_cases.title: Archive Approved Work
use_cases.description: Save reviewed plans to Obsidian or Bear so team decisions remain searchable after implementation.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my implementation plan with plannotator before coding. Help me identify risky steps and prepare feedback for approval or revision.

prompt_templates.title: Check Current Changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Open a plannotator review for my current git changes. Summarize the main risks and collect line-specific feedback before I continue.

prompt_templates.title: Set Up Agent Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Configure plannotator for my AI coding tool after I review the setup script. Explain which local configuration files will change first.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Full Review Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use plannotator to review the plan, wait for approval, then review the resulting diff and prepare a concise feedback summary.

output_examples.input: A draft implementation plan for a new authentication flow.
output_examples.output: Annotated plan feedback with one rejected step, two requested clarifications, and a final request for a revised plan.

output_examples.input: Uncommitted changes after an AI agent finishes a feature.
output_examples.output: A visual diff review summary with line-specific comments about tests, edge cases, and cleanup tasks.

output_examples.input: An approved plan that should be kept for project records.
output_examples.output: A saved notes entry containing the reviewed plan, decision state, tags, and project context.

best_practices: Review each setup script before allowing it to modify AI tool configuration.
Keep annotations tied to one concrete change or acceptance criterion.
Use diff review after implementation to verify the agent followed the approved plan.
anti_patterns: Running the remote installer without checking what it downloads.
Approving broad plans that do not include tests or rollback criteria.
Saving sensitive plans to shared notes vaults without access controls.

faq.question: What does plannotator do?
faq.answer: It opens a browser UI for reviewing AI agent plans and git diffs with structured annotations and approval decisions.

faq.question: Which tools does it support?
faq.answer: The skill documents integrations for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and OpenCode.

faq.question: Does it change local configuration?
faq.answer: Yes. The setup scripts can write hooks, prompts, plugin entries, and shell environment variables under the user home directory.

faq.question: Does it require network access?
faq.answer: The installer uses plannotator.ai, and documentation links to project, schema, and notes application sites.

faq.question: Can it review code after implementation?
faq.answer: Yes. The review script opens plannotator against current git changes, a commit, or a branch range.

faq.question: Can it save plans to notes apps?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents optional Obsidian filesystem export and Bear callback export when local apps are configured.
